titel: Stop the bulging first layer before you slice 🐘 #blender #3dprinting
printzin: Every printer is different: print a small test first.

scenes.tekst: Does the bottom edge of your print bulge out, like a little lip?
scenes.label: QUICK CHECK

scenes.tekst: That is elephant foot. The first layer gets squished wider than the rest.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: Give the bottom edge a small slope in Blender, before you slice.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Press Tab for Edit Mode, then 3 for face select.
scenes.label: STEP 1
scenes.uitspraak: Press Tab for Edit Mode, then three for face select.

scenes.tekst: Open View, Viewpoint, Bottom. Then click the bottom face.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Press Control B, type 0.5, and press Enter.
scenes.label: STEP 3
scenes.uitspraak: Press Control B, type zero point five, and press Enter.

scenes.tekst: Now the bottom edge has a slope of half a millimeter, all the way around.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Print guides suggest 0.2 to 0.5 mm. The wider first layer fills that slope.
scenes.label: WHY IT WORKS
scenes.uitspraak: Print guides suggest zero point two to zero point five millimeters. The wider first layer fills that slope.

scenes.tekst: Every printer is different, so print a small test first. Save this for your next print.
scenes.label: PRINT FIRST

scenes.tekst: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
scenes.label: CLICK JOINTS PRO
scenes.uitspraak: Make your prints poseable: Click Joints Pro, on Gumroad.
